data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 15.0m (2018: favourable development of GBP 3.5m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 13.6m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 1.6m in respect of total Reinsurance business.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2019 the Syndicate's opening gross claims reserves were GBP 514.3m. Using the gross claims development triangle the aggregate prior-year movement (UW years 2011-2017) shows a net gross strengthening of approximately GBP 30.5m (adverse development), largely driven by increases in several older underwriting years (notably 2017). The Syndicate's notes state a net favourable prior year development of GBP 15.0m (net of reinsurance recoveries), comprised mainly of net releases in direct Third Party Liability and reinsurance acceptances; the difference between the gross adverse movement and the reported net favourable movement is explained by reinsurance recoveries. The movements therefore reflect a mix of adverse gross development on older years offset by reinsurance recoveries and selected favourable development in casualty and reinsurance lines.

data.data_quality_notes: The specific 'Movement in prior year's provision' note reports a NET favourable development of GBP 15.0m (explicit). That note provides net (after reinsurance) figures. No gross aggregate prior-year movement is given in that note, so the gross prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 36) as a fallback. This yields a gross strengthening of about GBP 30.531m (adverse), while the net figure reported is a GBP 15.0m release - the difference is due to reinsurance recoveries. Gross PYD derived from triangle is subject to triangle alignment and exclusion of the '2010 & prior' aggregate column as required, confidence 0.8.
